/bin/bash -lc 'go mod edit -modfile=/tmp/vuls-fortinet-test.mod -require=gorm.io/gorm@v1.25.4 && GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -mod=mod -modfile=/tmp/vuls-fortinet-test.mod ./detector ./models ./server'

/bin/bash -lc 'gofmt -w detector/cve_client.go detector/detector.go detector/detector_test.go models/cvecontents.go models/utils.go models/vulninfos.go models/fortinet_test.go server/server.go && git diff --check && test -z "$(gofmt -l detector/cve_client.go detector/detector.go detector/detector_test.go models/cvecontents.go models/utils.go models/vulninfos.go models/fortinet_test.go server/server.go)" && GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -mod=mod ./detector ./models ./server'

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
